body:
### Problem


When a command has more than one `:filter` modifier, e.g. `:filter /a/ filter /b/ ls`,
`parse_command_modifiers()` overwrites the previous pattern and compiled regexp without freeing
them (`src/nvim/ex_docmd.c`):

```c
      if (!skip_only) {
        cmod->cmod_filter_pat = xstrdup(reg_pat);                            // l.2601
        cmod->cmod_filter_regmatch.regprog = vim_regcomp(reg_pat, RE_MAGIC); // l.2602
```

`undo_cmdmod()` later frees only the last pattern and regprog, so every extra `filter` leaks
one regprog plus one pattern string. The last `filter` wins (that does not change), only the
memory of the earlier ones is lost.

It happens both when the command is executed (`do_one_cmd()`) and when it is only parsed with
`nvim_parse_cmd()` (`parse_cmdline()`), so it is reachable from Lua plugins and RPC clients.

In a normal (non-ASan) build the memory grows with every call: running
`filter /a/ filter /b/ ls` 200,000 times raised RSS by about 68 MB (~355 bytes per call),
while `filter /a/ ls` 200,000 times raised it by under 1 MB (see steps). A longer pattern leaks more.

Found by fuzzing the Ex command parser (`nvim_parse_cmd()`) with libFuzzer + ASan/LSan.

A possible fix is to free the previous values before storing the new ones:

```c
      if (!skip_only) {
        xfree(cmod->cmod_filter_pat);
        vim_regfree(cmod->cmod_filter_regmatch.regprog);
        cmod->cmod_filter_pat = xstrdup(reg_pat);
        cmod->cmod_filter_regmatch.regprog = vim_regcomp(reg_pat, RE_MAGIC);
```

Vim has the same code (`ex_docmd.c`, `cmod->cmod_filter_regmatch.regprog = vim_regcomp(...)`
without freeing the previous one) and leaks the regprog the same way.


### Steps to reproduce

Memory growth in a normal build (each line runs the command 200,000 times and prints how much
the resident memory grew):

```sh
nvim --clean --headless +"lua local m = vim.uv.resident_set_memory(); for _ = 1, 200000 do vim.cmd('silent filter /a/ ls') end; print((vim.uv.resident_set_memory() - m) / 2^20, 'MB')" +q
# 0.375 MB   (varies a little between runs, always under 1 MB)
nvim --clean --headless +"lua local m = vim.uv.resident_set_memory(); for _ = 1, 200000 do vim.cmd('silent filter /a/ filter /b/ ls') end; print((vim.uv.resident_set_memory() - m) / 2^20, 'MB')" +q
# 67.75 MB
```

With an ASan build (`-DENABLE_ASAN_UBSAN=ON`), one call is enough:

```sh
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 nvim --clean --headless +"filter /a/ filter /b/ ls" +q
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 nvim --clean --headless +"lua vim.api.nvim_parse_cmd('filter /a/ filter /b/ ls', {})" +q
```

LeakSanitizer output (trimmed), executed command:

```
Direct leak of 256 byte(s) in 1 object(s) allocated from:
    #2 in xmalloc src/nvim/memory.c:149:15
    #3 in nfa_regcomp src/nvim/regexp.c:15988:10
    #4 in vim_regcomp src/nvim/regexp.c:16204:12
    #5 in parse_command_modifiers src/nvim/ex_docmd.c:2602:46
    #6 in do_one_cmd src/nvim/ex_docmd.c:2037:7
Direct leak of 2 byte(s) in 1 object(s) allocated from:
    #2 in xmalloc src/nvim/memory.c:149:15
    #3 in xmallocz src/nvim/memory.c:221:15
    #4 in xmemdupz src/nvim/memory.c:239:17
    #5 in xstrdup src/nvim/memory.c:486:10
    #6 in parse_command_modifiers src/nvim/ex_docmd.c:2601:33
```

`nvim_parse_cmd()`: the same two leaks, via `parse_cmdline src/nvim/ex_docmd.c:1510` ←
`nvim_parse_cmd src/nvim/api/command.c:135`. With three `filter` modifiers the leak doubles
(512 + 4 bytes in 2 objects each); `filter /a/ ls` alone leaks nothing.

### Expected behavior

No memory is leaked when a command has more than one `:filter` modifier; memory use stays
flat when such a command is run repeatedly.

### Nvim version (nvim -v)

NVIM v0.13.0-dev-54f94d6fc4 (master); also NVIM v0.12.0-dev (Ubuntu package 0.12.0~ubuntu1+git202601110810-d62bbe24cb)

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

yes, Vim 9.2.1252 (ASan build: 259 bytes leaked per extra `:filter`, from `parse_command_modifiers` `ex_docmd.c:3133`) and 9.1.2141 (200,000 calls: RSS +70.4 MB vs +9.2 MB with one `:filter`). Reported as vim/vim#21669.

### Operating system/version

Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS (Linux 7.0.0-34-generic, x86_64)

### Terminal name/version

kitty 0.45.0 (not terminal related, also reproduces with `--headless`)

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-kitty

### Installation

build from repo (master 54f94d6, `CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug`, `ENABLE_ASAN_UBSAN=ON`, clang); also Ubuntu system package

comment_data.body: This is extremely uncommon, thus low priority.

milestone.description: We don't plan to work on this, but will accept high quality contributions from someone who will own the feature and follow up on bug reports.
milestone.title: needs-owner

title: memory leak: repeated `:filter` modifier leaks the earlier pattern and regprog
